# Allowed git author/committer email addresses for this repository.
# Enforced by the "Commit Identity Audit" workflow (.github/workflows/commit-audit.yml)
# on every push to main and every pull request. Matching is case-insensitive.
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS:
#   A fabricated identity "OrientCOMPASS-bot <bot@users.noreply.github.com>" was once
#   used in a commit. GitHub attributes commits by email, and <login>@users.noreply.github.com
#   maps to the REAL account holding that login — so the commit was credited to the
#   unrelated external user https://github.com/bot and polluted the contributor list.
#   Fixing it required rewriting published history and force-pushing.
#
# RULE:
#   Never invent an email. Use exactly one of the identities below.
#   To add a new legitimate identity, update this file in the same change that uses it.

# Repository owner — legacy noreply form (used by all existing history)
orientcompass@users.noreply.github.com

# Repository owner — modern noreply form (account id 316423573)
316423573+orientcompass@users.noreply.github.com

# GitHub Actions automation (commits/merges made with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN)
41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com

# GitHub web UI operations (e.g. merging a PR in the browser); attributes to nobody
noreply@github.com
